[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Similar tasks band in Bob Mac Capture[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]When a capture draft will create new tasks, Bob Mac Capture quietly[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shows the few existing tasks each one may duplicate. The rows [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]appear after typing settles, at the foot of the new task's own [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]preview card, and take zero pixels otherwise. One keyboard-driven [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]draft edit can fold, relate, or link a match, and typing, the live [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]preview, and Return stay exactly as fast as today.[/#D7D7AF]
